classification: Optional display failure after complete typechecking, caused by print_axioms:true with no pretty-printer output destination. No proof check was skipped.

evidence.main.rs: use_config calls check_all_declars() before pp_selected_declars(), then emits the no-typechecker-errors report when only display errors remain.
evidence.pretty_printer.rs: pp_selected_declars returns Unable to print axioms when print_axioms is true and pp_destination is None.
evidence.util.rs: get_pp_destination returns None without pp_output_path or pp_to_stdout:true.
evidence.parser.rs: unpermitted_axiom_hard_error:true fails import for an unpermitted axiom.

future_display_setting: Add pp_to_stdout:true to a copy of the direct NanoDa configuration to display axioms; this changes output only. The actual successful run configuration and raw log are preserved.
